title: Equalizer right adjoint for an augmented simplicial topos
statement: Let $(\mathcal E_n,f_\alpha^{-1})$ be a coherent simplicial diagram of sites/topoi indexed by $\Delta^{op}$ [def-weil-pbc-topos] [def-weil-size-convention], with total site $\mathcal E_{\mathrm{tot}}$ constructed by [lem-trf-slice-site-total-pseudofunctor]. Let $\mathcal D$ be a topos [def-weil-pbc-topos] with inverse-image functors $a_n^{-1}:\mathcal D\to\mathrm{Sh}(\mathcal E_n)$ and coherent identifications $f_\alpha^{-1}a_q^{-1}\cong a_p^{-1}$ for every $\alpha:[p]\to[q]$. Use the equivalence of $\mathrm{Sh}(\mathcal E_{\mathrm{tot}})$ with compatible systems $(F_n,t_\alpha)$ (with arbitrary transition maps) supplied by [lem-trf-slice-site-total-systems]. Then $G\mapsto(a_n^{-1}G)_n$, with its canonical transitions, defines a geometric morphism [def-trf-geometric-morphism] from $\mathrm{Sh}(\mathcal E_{\mathrm{tot}})$ to $\mathcal D$. Its right adjoint sends a compatible system $(F_n,t_\alpha)$ to the equalizer in $\mathcal D$ of the two maps $a_{0,*}F_0\rightrightarrows a_{1,*}F_1$ associated to the two maps $[0]\to[1]$. The equalizer is characterized by the fact that a map into it is exactly a compatible family of maps $a_n^{-1}G\to F_n$; the identity and cocycle laws follow from the coherence data.
